caption:
No Oil Paneer Tikka Quinoa Salad
no oil recipe | protein | make ahead | meal prep friendly |

Nutrition: 
Macros: C: 48 | F: 16 | P: 27
Calories: 494 per serve for paneer | 395 per serve if using tofu 
Serves 3

Ingredients 
200 grams paneer, can be subbed with paneer or chicken too 
marinade
1 - 2 tbsp thick curd
1 tsp ginger garlic paste
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp haldi powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tsp chaat masala 
Salt to taste

Dressing 
3/4 cup greek yogurt 
large bunch of coriander leaves + some stems wont matter as it will be blended
chaat masala, to flavour
salt to taste
1/2 chilli, optional to add spice
1-2 cloves garlic, for flavour 

to assemble, 
3/4 cup quinoa, cooked 
any lettuce of choice 
cubed cucumber 
sliced tomatoes
any other vegetables of choice 
pickled onions 

Method 
marinate paneer as per ingredients mentioned above
set aside in the fridge till ready to cook

to make the dressing, blend together all the ingredients mentioned, season as per taste and leave in fridge till time to serve

cook the marinated paneer in a pan, you dont need any oil for this 

to assemble, add a bed of lettuce to a bowl, add in quinoa, paneer, cucumber and pickled onions
serve with the dressing and enjoy :)
